figures.label: Typical Salary Range
figures.source: Entry pay across PCB career options with salary spans a huge range, government Medical Officers start near ₹8-12 LPA gross with allowances, fresh private-hospital nurses often start near ₹1.8-3 LPA, and a first-year pharmacist can start anywhere from ₹1.2 LPA (D.Pharm retail) to ₹6.2 LPA (Pharm.D).

blocks.heading: Typical Entry Roughly Rs 2
rows: Roughly Rs 2.5-3 LPA (about Rs 12,000-25,000/month) for most fresh BPT graduates in clinics and mid-tier hospitals, regardless of how the role is titled.
Roughly Rs 3-5 LPA in sports-physio roles, sports teams and specialist sports-medicine setups pay somewhat more, but these are a small number of seats.
Roughly Rs 4-12 LPA with an MPT (Master of Physiotherapy) or a move into a corporate hospital chain, the clearest Tier 2 lever most physiotherapists actually use.

Considerably more, for a very small number of people. National-team or IPL-level sports physio roles pay well above the rest of this list, treat this as a rare Tier 3 outcome, not a realistic entry plan.

blocks.heading: Nursing Salary: Private, Government, and Abroad

items.text: Government and central institutions like AIIMS or ESIC often start meaningfully higher once allowances stack onto the 7th CPC Staff Nurse scale (Level VII, roughly Rs 44,900-1,42,400 basic).
Research associate, quality, or sales-adjacent roles are the common first job, in the roughly Rs 21,000-41,000/month range.
A UGC/CSIR-type research fellowship during a PhD commonly pays roughly Rs 31,000-37,000/month, plan around that runway, not the eventual post-PhD number, while you are still studying.

figures.label: Relevant Experience Window
figures.source: With 3-5 years of experience and a CPC or CCS credential, pay commonly moves to Rs 6-13.8 LPA, and senior auditors or specialty coders can reach Rs 12-20 LPA.
